content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question regarding the [product_name] expansion module. Is it possible to connect the M1 pin of the 0-10V analog output to the negative terminal of my DC power supply? Thank you for your help.

Based on the wiring diagram, the two analog outputs are active and provide a variable 0 to 10 V signal. Connecting M1 from output 1 to your power supply's 0V terminal may introduce electrical noise, though it usually won't damage the module. For accurate analog signal reference, make sure any other device reading the 0-10V signal has its 0V connected to M1, maintaining a common reference. It's also recommended to use the same power supply's 0V connections for all equipment involved. If two modules are using different power supplies but are exchanging the 0-10V signal, their 0V terminals should be linked for a consistent reference.

Responses emphasize the importance of maintaining a shared 0V reference across modules and devices to ensure proper analog signal transmission and minimize electrical noise.
